name: AirTrunk Malaysia hyperscale platform (JHB1-JHB4, Johor Bahru)
location: Iskandar Puteri / Johor Bahru, Malaysia (four campuses: JHB1-JHB4)
description: AirTrunk's Malaysian hyperscale platform: four campuses in Johor Bahru totalling more than 700 MW of IT capacity and about USD 6.8 billion of investment — the anchor data-centre supply for the Johor-Singapore AI corridor. JHB1 (150+ MW) opened July 2024 as an AI-ready facility with one of the largest direct-to-chip liquid-cooling deployments; JHB2 (about 280 MW, announced February 2025) carries USD 2.3 billion of green financing; JHB3 and JHB4 (about 280 MW combined) were announced April 2026 under a MYR 12 billion investment.

capacities.basis: combined across four campuses; about USD 6.8 billion total investment in Malaysia

source.note: AirTrunk site banner: AIRTRUNK EXPANDS MALAYSIA PLATFORM TO 700MW+, read 2026-11-12
